list.label: Nano Banana 2.1
list.description: Latest high-efficiency Nano Banana. Better realism, prompt adherence, text rendering and character consistency at Flash speed. Great for campaigns, infographics, and iterative edits.

list.label: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst
list.description: OpenAI's most capable GPT Image 2.5 tier, built for editing precision; takes text and image input and outputs images in low, medium, high, xhigh, or max quality.

list.label: GPT Image 2.5 Flare
list.description: OpenAI's fastest GPT Image 2.5 tier for high-quality everyday image generation and editing; takes text and image input and outputs images.

list.label: Flux 2 Pro
list.description: Black Forest Labs FLUX.2 [pro] text-to-image and multi-reference editing model served via Prodia; takes a prompt and up to 8 input images and outputs up to 4096x4096.

list.label: FLUX 3 Image Klein
list.description: Black Forest Labs FLUX 3 Image Klein, the fast open-weights FLUX 3 model; text-to-image and editing with up to 10 reference images.

list.label: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image
list.description: Nano Banana (legacy Gemini 2.5 Flash Image) native image generation and editing model for high-volume, low-latency creative workflows.

list.label: GPT-image-2
list.description: The most capable model for image editing and complex creative instructions. Excels at text rendering, visual consistency, design generation, and iterative refinement.

list.label: Grok Imagine Image 2.0
list.description: xAI Grok Imagine Image 2.0 text-to-image and editing; takes a prompt and up to 5 images and outputs 1K or 2K in low or medium quality.

list.label: Ideogram 4.5
list.description: Ideogram's precise edit model: repeated edits keep the untouched pixels and colours intact, at the source's native resolution. Also generates from text.

list.label: Kling Image 3.0
list.description: Kling Image 3.0 text-to-image and single-image restyling; takes a prompt and an optional reference image and outputs 1K or 2K.

list.label: Kling Image O3
list.description: Kling Image O3 text-to-image and multi-reference image editing; takes a prompt and up to 10 reference images and outputs 1K, 2K or 4K.

list.label: Krea 3
list.description: Krea 3 photoreal image generation and multi-image editing; takes a prompt and up to 8 reference images and outputs up to 4 megapixels.

list.label: Meta Muse
list.description: Meta's image model with built-in world knowledge and strong prompt adherence. Great for concept-rich scenes, realistic compositions, and reference-guided edits.

list.label: Nano Banana 2
list.description: Generate high-quality images at speed. Perfect for brainstorming, moodboards, concept testing, creative exploration, and large batch workflows.

list.label: Nano Banana Lite
list.description: The fastest and most affordable image model. Ideal for rapid drafts, bulk exploration, and iterative concept testing at 1K resolution.

list.label: Nano Banana Pro
list.description: Create stunning, production-quality visuals with exceptional realism, detail, and typography. Best for campaigns, e-commerce, product photography, and hero creatives.

list.label: Qwen Image 2 Pro
list.description: Alibaba Qwen Image 2 Pro unified text-to-image and editing model; takes a prompt plus an optional single reference image and generates native 2K output.

list.label: Qwen Image 3
list.description: Alibaba Qwen Image 3 text-to-image and multi-image editing with strong text rendering; takes a prompt and up to 3 reference images and outputs 1K or 2K.

list.label: Recraft V4.1 Flash
list.description: Recraft V4.1 Flash fast design-first text-to-image for brand, editorial and layout work; takes a prompt and outputs a raster image.

list.label: Seedream 4.5
list.description: ByteDance Seedream 4.5 text-to-image and image-to-image with up to 14 reference images and batch image-set generation; outputs 2K or 4K.

list.label: Seedream 5 Pro
list.description: ByteDance Seedream 5.0 Pro text-to-image and multi-reference image-to-image (up to 10 inputs) with region editing; outputs 1K, 1.5K, or 2K.

list.label: SenseNova U1 Infographic
list.description: SenseNova U1 Infographic turns a detailed prompt into a laid-out infographic with charts, sections and legible text.

list.label: WAN 2.7 Image Pro
list.description: Alibaba Wan 2.7 Image Pro text-to-image and image-editing model; takes a prompt plus up to 9 reference images and generates up to 4K (4096x4096).

list.label: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash
list.description: Google Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 conversational video generation and editing; text, image, and up to 10-second video input, 3-10 second output at up to 4K and 24 FPS.

list.label: Grok Imagine
list.description: xAI's reference-to-video model. Generates short clips conditioned on up to 5 reference images with flexible aspect ratios.

list.label: Grok Imagine 1.5
list.description: xAI Grok Imagine 1.5: text- and image-to-video at native 1080p with lip-synced audio, or up to 14 reference images and pinned first and last frames at 720p, 1-15 seconds.

list.label: Happy Horse 1.1
list.description: Alibaba Happy Horse 1.1: text-to-video, image-to-video and reference-to-video from up to 9 images, with native audio and lip-sync, 3-15 seconds at up to 1080p.

list.label: Kling 2.5
list.description: Kuaishou Kling 2.5 Turbo Pro image-to-video; animates a single input image from a text prompt, 5- or 10-second clips.

list.label: Kling 3.0
list.description: Kuaishou Kling 3.0 Pro image-to-video; a required start image plus a text prompt (or multi-shot prompts) with optional end image and native audio, 3-15 second clips.

list.label: Kling O3
list.description: Kuaishou Kling O3 Pro: text, start/end frames and up to 7 reference images in one 3-15 second clip with consistent characters and optional native audio.

list.label: Kling V3 Omni
list.description: Kuaishou Kling Video 3.0 Omni unified generation and editing from text, start/end images, up to 7 reference images, and reference video; up to 15 seconds at up to 4K.

list.label: MiniMax H3
list.description: MiniMax H3 multimodal video model for text-to-video, image-to-video (first/last frame), and reference-to-video with native audio, up to 2K.

list.label: MiniMax H3 Max
list.description: High-speed MiniMax H3 Max variant for text-to-video and image-to-video (first/last frame) only, up to 1080p.

list.label: MiniMax H3 Max Reference
list.description: MiniMax H3 Max reference-to-video on fal; conditions on reference images, videos, and audio. MiniMax's own docs do not list a reference mode for H3 Max.

list.label: MiniMax H3 Max Turbo
list.description: The fast tier of MiniMax H3 Max: text-to-video and start/end-frame image-to-video with native audio and an optional soundtrack clip, up to 15 seconds at 1080p.

list.label: MiniMax H3 Reference
list.description: MiniMax H3 reference-to-video mode guided by up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos, and 3 audio clips; reference and image-to-video inputs cannot be mixed.

list.label: Seedance 2.0
list.description: High-quality AI video generation with reference image conditioning. Supports 4-15 second clips with human preprocessing.

list.label: Seedance 2.0 Fast
list.description: Speed- and cost-optimized ByteDance Seedance 2.0 Fast; text plus image, video, and audio references to generate or edit 4-15 second clips.

list.label: Seedance 2.5
list.description: ByteDance Seedance 2.5 for long-form storytelling and omni-reference generation/editing; up to 50 reference assets and 4-30 second clips at up to 1080p.

list.label: Wan 3
list.description: Alibaba Wan 3 video model for text-to-video, image-to-video (start/end frame), and reference-to-video from up to 10 images, 5 videos and 5 audio clips, with native audio; 2-30 seconds at up to 1080p.
